tools.name: get_geography
tools.description: Inspect one published geometry family across scopes or one scope across families. Returns coverage and known editions from catalog metadata only. Optional year selects the latest admitted edition no later than that year when the selected catalog has an edition index; an unavailable index is reported

tools.name: resolve_bbox
tools.description: Compare one non-wrapping rectangular WGS84 viewport in one scope. Omit scope_id for Global GeoBoundaries Admin 0-2, or supply one published ISO3 country for its own Admin 0-3 geometry and loc_ids. Returns the best equal-area overlap plus nearby matches at each level and their shares of the viewport

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "reverse-geocoding?registry=mcpregistry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: resolve_deep_point.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: resolve_deep_point

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
